correctness.rationale: Ind(C12)≃S3∨S3 (classical cycle calculation) is simply connected. Rotations r^3 and r^4 have fixed barycentres and generate C12, so Armstrong gives π1=0. Independently enumerated rotation-orbit flag-cell boundaries have d²=0 and Burnside-agreed counts. The packaged exact replay checks 1,242 genuine elementary free-face collapses and 359 invertible Z unit pivots, leaving only a degree-zero chain group; this proves integral acyclicity. Hurewicz and Whitehead prove contractibility. The complete executable and certificate are embedded and replayed.

value.rationale: This canonical first joint order-three/order-four isotropy cycle yields a new integral homotopy classification where prior rational acyclicity and π1=0 left hidden higher torsion undecided. Its noncontractible two-3-sphere covering complex becomes contractible under rotations. The exact certificate makes the meaningful torsion-exclusion check portable without pretending a general theorem or independent audit.
